An '''Intruder Gate''' was a security measure protecting the [[Officer/Legends|officer]] quarters and [[Computer/Legends|computer]] center aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]]. They were [[Iron/Legends|iron]] grilles that barred entry.
